rule: A template uses ONE section per group (header, hero, about, menu, reviews, contact, footer; gallery optional), in an order that suits the brief, and adapts each one (copy, spacing, which kit button / hover / reveal). Facts and story lists may only contain real data.

sections.name: Centred name
sections.description: The name in the middle, links split left and right on desktop. Classic and calm.

sections.name: Floating pill
sections.description: A rounded glass bar floating over the page, with name, links and one action.

sections.name: Simple header
sections.description: Name left, anchor links on desktop, one action. Turns to glass on scroll.

sections.name: Editorial name
sections.description: The restaurant name set huge across the page; a photo overlaps the type. Bold and memorable.

sections.name: Framed
sections.description: Wide photo inside a frame of the primary colour, title below on the frame. Calm and premium.

sections.name: Full-bleed photo
sections.description: Photo fills the screen, name and actions sit bottom-left over a soft dark gradient.

sections.name: Headline + dish ticker
sections.description: Headline, then a tilted band where dish names glide slowly across, then a wide photo. Lively but calm; pauses on hover.

sections.name: Mosaic
sections.description: A coloured title card next to three photos. Shows food, place and people at once.

sections.name: Photo collage
sections.description: Three photos overlapping like prints on a table, slightly turned; they shift a little on hover.

sections.name: Split
sections.description: Text panel on the page colour, tall photo on the right. With data-shape=arch the photo becomes an arch.

sections.name: Headline + photo strip
sections.description: Big headline first, then a swipeable strip of photos. Feels like a magazine.

sections.name: Photo and story
sections.description: Photo beside the story text; works with one photo. Clear and warm.

sections.name: Two-photo collage
sections.description: A large photo with a smaller one overlapping its corner, story beside them.

sections.name: Facts in numbers
sections.description: Short story plus up to four real facts as counting numbers (rating, reviews, years, seats). Only real data.

sections.name: Statement
sections.description: The story as one large statement, no photo. Strong when the text is short and personal.

sections.name: Timeline
sections.description: The story as years and moments. Only when the history is real and known.

sections.name: Chalkboard
sections.description: The menu on a dark board in the primary colour, big dish names, prices in the accent colour.

sections.name: Two-column list
sections.description: Clean menu list in two columns on desktop, one on phones.

sections.name: Signature dishes
sections.description: Three to six dishes as photo cards. Needs good dish photos.

sections.name: Printed menu card
sections.description: The menu as an elegant card with a double border, like a printed menu on the table.

sections.name: Sticky intro + list
sections.description: Intro text stays in place on desktop while the menu scrolls next to it.

sections.name: Masonry
sections.description: Photos of different heights in columns, like a mood board.

sections.name: Mosaic
sections.description: First photo large, the rest in a tidy grid.

sections.name: Swipe strip
sections.description: Photos in a horizontal strip you can swipe.

sections.name: One large, two small
sections.description: Three photos: one tall, two stacked. Calm and balanced.

sections.name: Review cards
sections.description: Three review cards side by side.

sections.name: Gliding reviews
sections.description: Review cards glide slowly sideways and pause when touched or hovered. Static for visitors who turn motion off.

sections.name: Rating + quotes
sections.description: The Google rating as a big number, with short quotes beside it.

sections.name: Large quotes
sections.description: Each review as a large centred quote. Use with 1 to 3 strong reviews.

sections.name: Dark action band
sections.description: A strong coloured band with the main actions. Good as the last section.

sections.name: Card over photo
sections.description: A contact card floating over a full-width photo.

sections.name: Hours + map
sections.description: Opening hours and contact on one side, a map link panel on the other.

sections.name: Reservation ticket
sections.description: Contact as a ticket: hours on the main part, a torn-off stub with the phone number and booking.

sections.name: Big name
sections.description: Contact and links on top, the restaurant name set huge across the bottom edge.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Name, contact, social links, photo credit.
